{{Top|leg|italics=1|notoc=1}}
{{Youmay|the warship|[[Ecliptic (disambiguation)|other uses of the word]]}}
The '''''Ecliptic''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] warship under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The ''Ecliptic'' was at the frontline during the [[Battle of Serroco]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ecliptic.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Dallan Morvis]] mentions "the ''Ecliptic''" in [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]] (left), and "the [[Wikipedia:ecliptic|ecliptic]]" in [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Volume 3: Days of Fear, Nights of Anger|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Days of Fear, Nights of Anger'']] (right).]]
{{Quote|Before it winds up wrong on someone's website, '''the word "ecliptic"''' does not refer to a spaceship by that name, Rand or otherwise. They're referring to the plane of the ecliptic, which is defined by Serroco's star and the orbit of the planet around it.|[[John Jackson Miller]]|<ref name="KOTOR15notes" />}}
The ''Ecliptic'' was first mentioned in [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]. Although author [[John Jackson Miller]] intended for the dialogue to refer to "[[Wikipedia:ecliptic|ecliptic]]" as an astronomical term,<ref name="KOTOR15notes">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor15.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #15''}}</ref> the word was italicized in the finished issue, leading some readers to conclude it was a starship. Additionally, all letters in the issue were capitalized, leading to further ambiguity regarding the question of whether or not the word was used as a proper noun. Later, the word "ecliptic" was no longer italicized when the ''Days of Fear'' arc was reprinted in [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Volume 3: Days of Fear, Nights of Anger|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Days of Fear, Nights of Anger'']], corresponding with Miller's original intention. However, this change was later contradicted by ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', where it received an entry, thus canonizing the ''Ecliptic''{{'s}} existence as a starship.
